Dear Affiliate Team,

Before my request, I wanted to ask whether a custom affiliate coupon code
will be fully trackable for commissions, so that any purchases made using
the code are correctly attributed to my affiliate account.

My name is Adyant, and I am an approved affiliate of your website. I am
reaching out to request a unique coupon code named "····" that I can use
to promote your products/services to my audience.

Registered Email: (email hidden)

If possible, could you please provide me with a coupon code that I can
share with my audience? I am excited to continue promoting your brand and
appreciate any assistance you can provide.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to your positive
response.

Best regards,
Adyant
Handed to the team · Affiliate coupon creation and commission tracking are not mine to set up or prom

Hi Adyant,

Thanks for reaching out, and for promoting us.

Affiliate codes and the commission tracking behind them aren't something I can set up or confirm from my side, so I've passed your request straight to Georges on our team. He handles affiliate partnerships and discount codes, including whether "····" can be issued and how attribution is recorded against your account.

He's picking it up today and will reply to you here on (email hidden) with the details.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
